messages:
Auditor (Lisa): hi, we need SOC 2 fieldwork artifacts for the 2026-03-10 vuln triage. specifically: 1) a live-replay snippet (trimmed) showing the RBAC change to svc-infer, 2) KMS decrypt log entries for the key used by the infer pipeline during the triage window, and 3) chain-of-custody notes. presigned link ok.
Zoe H: got it. can you confirm exact UTC window? and do you want a verbatim terminal session or just the event timeline (jsonl)?
Auditor (Lisa): window = 2026-03-10 14:22:00 -> 14:57:00 UTC. timeline jsonl + correlation mapping is fine. redact IPs and unrelated emails.
Mike D: plan: extract k8s audit events for roleBinding changes + cloud IAM admin activity, plus KMS Audit logs (Decrypt operations) filtered by key_id. will generate rbac_events.jsonl, kms_decrypts.jsonl, and a correlation.csv with timestamp alignment.
Raj P: extraction commands I'll run:
```
# k8s audit grep (example)
jq -c '.items[] | select(.objectRef.kind=="RoleBinding" or .verb=="update")' /var/log/k8s/audit.log 
# cloud audit (GCP/AWS)
gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.methodName:"Decrypt" AND timestamp>="2026-03-10T14:22:00Z"' --format=json
```
Lina S: redaction rules: mask IPs to /24, replace non-scope emails with redwood-redacted@example.com, remove command outputs from jumpbox sessions. will include redaction checklist in README.
evidence-bot: evidence job created -> EV-2026-914
Mike D: starting extraction now. ETA ~12m. will stage artifacts to s3://redwood-evidence/temp/EV-2026-914/ then presign.
Zoe H: @Mike @Raj add a short README.md that contains: queries used, sha256 hashes of artifacts, redaction rationale, and presign expiry. auditor will want the mapping that ties the RBAC event to the service account used in the KMS Decrypt call.
Mike D: noted. also will include delta: whether the roleBinding change was additive (role added) or revoke.
Raj P: extraction complete. produced files: rbac_events.jsonl (5 entries), kms_decrypts.jsonl (3 entries), correlation.csv (rows: rbac_ts,kms_ts,actor,resource,comment). hashes: rbac_events sha256: 9b2f...d12, kms_decrypts sha256: e43a...7f0.
Lina S: redaction applied. checklist: IP mask applied, non-scope emails replaced, jumpbox commands removed. retention: presign 72h.
evidence-bot: presign ready -> https://s3.redwood-example.com/ev/EV-2026-914?sig=REDACTED (72h)
Mike D: README uploaded, correlation.csv uploaded. please verify access.
Auditor (Lisa): I can access the link. quick questions: 1) do KMS logs include key alias or only key id? 2) we need proof that the decrypt was invoked by svc-infer SA and not another SA.
Zoe H: 1) our cloud provider returns both key_id and alias in audit events. 2) correlation.csv includes callerEmail and requestMetadata. We matched serviceAccount email to the RBAC change actor within +/- 30s. see README for matching logic.
Mike D: added explicit chain-of-custody paragraph: extraction operator, extraction time, hashing, redaction, upload actor, and presign id.
Auditor (Lisa): perfect. please keep artifact live for 72h. I'll mark as reviewed after I ingest. thanks team.
Lina S: logging ticket SEC-2026-314 created for evidence tracking. closing loop once auditor confirms. :white_check_mark:
